abilities.description:
Directs a Spirit-Warding Lamp to fire off a Troubleshooter Shot at opponents, dealing Electro DMG.
After the Troubleshooter Shot hits, it will create 2 After-Sales Service Rounds that will automatically track nearby opponents and deal Electro DMG.

abilities.name: Alcazarzaray's Exactitude
_curatorNotes: Jinni connection phase is a duration-bounded self-status on the connected active character (12s base from cast), not a spawned entity — per recipe (§3 Behavior field, duration-bounded self-status) it is not authored on summons[]. Reviewer to author the self-buff representation, including: continuous HP regen (Dori Max HP scaling), continuous Energy regen, Electro application via the connector, and a connector-DMG tick (~0.4s interval) on enemies between Jinni and active char. gcsim begins heal/energy ticks at frame 11 and the connector at frame 28 (burstHitmark).
Connected-character electro self-infusion: gcsim source has TODO comment ('TODO: find actual duration') on ApplySelfInfusion call — actual duration uncertain. Not modeled.
D cancel frame omitted: ActionDash remains at animation-length default (58 frames) after InitAbilSlice — no explicit ActionDash assignment in burst.go.
abilities.description:
Summons forth the Jinni within the lamp to give the client various kinds of aid.

Jinni
Connects to a nearby character. The connected character will:
· Continuously restore HP based on Dori's Max HP.
· Continuously regenerate Energy.
· Be affected by Electro.
When the connector between the Jinni and the character touches opponents, it will deal one instance of Electro DMG to them every 0.4s.

Only one Jinni can exist at one time.

passives.name: An Eye for Gold
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — CD reduction mechanic: after connected character triggers a listed Electro reaction, Troubleshooter Cannon CD is reduced by 1s (ICD: 3s). Reaction list needs KQM verification — gcsim subscribes to: Overload, Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, Crystallize (Electro), Swirl (Electro).
passives.description:
After a character connected to the Jinni triggers an Electro-Charged, Lunar-Charged, Superconduct, Overloaded, Quicken, Aggravate, Hyperbloom, Electro Swirl, or Electro Crystallize reaction, the CD of Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon is decreased by 1s.
This effect can be triggered once every 3s.

passives.name: Compound Interest
_curatorNotes: Effect not yet authored — energy regen scales on ER: restores 5 Energy per 100% ER (max 15 Energy) when Troubleshooter Shot or After-Sales Service Rounds hit. Scaling buff — value field intentionally absent per recipe. Reviewer to implement as BuffValue.scaling form.
passives.description:
When the Troubleshooter Shots or After-Sales Service Rounds from Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon hit opponents, Dori will restore 5 Elemental Energy for every 100% Energy Recharge possessed.
Per Spirit-Warding Lamp: Troubleshooter Cannon, only one instance of Energy restoration can be triggered and a maximum of 15 Energy can be restored this way.
